categories.main_business_segments: United Nova Technology Co., Ltd. (芯联集成) primarily operates in semiconductor manufacturing, focusing on power devices, MEMS, BCD, and MCU technology platforms. The company provides one-stop system foundry solutions including design services, wafer manufacturing, module packaging, application verification, and reliability testing, targeting automotive, AI, high-end consumer electronics, and industrial control sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced semiconductor technologies such as power IGBT, MOSFET, SiC MOSFET, and BCD processes with multiple technology nodes including 8-inch and 12-inch wafer production lines. It has developed leading packaging technologies for high-power IGBT/SiC modules and MEMS manufacturing platforms. The company emphasizes proprietary R&D with continuous innovation in power, MEMS, BCD, and MCU technologies, supported by a comprehensive production system integrating wafer fabrication and module packaging.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include automotive manufacturers, AI server and data center operators, industrial control system providers, and high-end consumer electronics companies. The company serves major Chinese mainstream car manufacturers and Tier 1 suppliers, as well as clients in renewable energy sectors such as photovoltaic and wind power. Its products are widely applied in new energy vehicles, AI computing, industrial automation, and consumer electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered and primarily operates in China, with major facilities in Shaoxing, Zhejiang Province. It serves domestic markets extensively and has growing engagement with international OEMs and Tier 1 customers, particularly in Asia. Export sales constitute a smaller portion of revenue compared to domestic sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: United Nova Technology operates primarily in the midstream semiconductor manufacturing segment, providing wafer foundry and module packaging services. It integrates upstream design services and downstream application verification and reliability testing, positioning itself as a comprehensive system foundry provider within the semiconductor supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on deepening its leadership in new energy core chips and modules, expanding AI and automotive electronics applications. It prioritizes R&D investment in advanced power semiconductor technologies, SiC MOSFETs, analog ICs, and MEMS sensors, aiming to enhance product integration and cost competitiveness. The company also pursues capacity expansion with new 12-inch wafer lines and fosters ecosystem growth through capital investments and strategic partnerships.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of semiconductor wafers, power modules, and related packaging services. The company also earns income from design and R&D services. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels to OEMs and system integrators, with a focus on long-term customer contracts and strategic collaborations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: United Nova Technology is positioned as a leading domestic player in China’s semiconductor foundry sector, especially in automotive-grade IGBT and SiC MOSFET production. It ranks among the top global MEMS foundries and is recognized as one of the largest car-grade IGBT producers in China. The company competes with international and domestic semiconductor foundries, leveraging its integrated system foundry model and advanced technology platforms to differentiate itself.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved record revenue of approximately RMB 6.51 billion, representing a 22.25% year-over-year increase, with EBITDA growing 131.86% to RMB 2.15 billion. Despite still operating at a net loss due to high fixed asset depreciation and R&D expenses, the net loss was reduced by over 50%. Total assets reached RMB 34.2 billion, reflecting an 8.34% increase, indicating rapid scale expansion and improving profitability metrics.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique one-stop system foundry service integrating design, wafer manufacturing, module packaging, and testing, which shortens product development cycles and reduces customer costs. Its advanced proprietary technologies in power semiconductors, SiC MOSFETs, and MEMS sensors provide high reliability and performance tailored for automotive, AI, and industrial applications. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive product ecosystem, and strategic supply chain management create a competitive moat and enable rapid response to diverse customer needs.
